definitions.explanation: The fluffy fiber from the cotton plant, or cotton as a material.
Soft material used to fill cushions, quilts, stuffed toys, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{綿|わた}100%⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綿|わた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦へたって→へたる：10679_hetaru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The stuffing in the pillow has gone flat.

examples.japanese: {綿|わた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧
{綿|わた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: I stuff cotton into the plush toy.

notes:
{綿|わた} refers to both the raw cotton fiber and the processed material used as stuffing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {綿|わた}100% (100% cotton - for clothing labels)
- {綿|わた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to stuff with cotton)
- {綿|わた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put cotton filling in)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧ is another reading for cotton fabric/cloth
- ⟦コットン→コットン：noentry⟧ is used mainly in fashion/cosmetics contexts
- ⟦{脱脂綿|だっしめん}→脱脂綿：noentry⟧ is absorbent cotton (medical cotton)
